title: simple-spawn-system
description: Simple server side spawn teleport mod with diamond cost
body:
Spawn Mod is a simple server-side Fabric mod that allows players to teleport to custom spawns.

Features:
- (OP) Set custom spawns with /setspawn <name>
- (OP) Delete spawns with /delspawn <name>
- Teleport with /spawn <name>
- List all spawns with /spawnlist
- Spawns are saved and persist after server restart
- Teleport costs 5 diamonds

This mod is server-side only – clients do not need to install it.

Perfect for survival servers that want a simple teleport system without plugins.
